pending_carry_forward.reason: frontend/src/services/userAuthService.js's login() is a deliberate mock that resolves for any non-empty email/password pair (no real credential check). Not reachable today — LoginScreen/LoginForm/userAuthService have zero references from App.jsx/main.jsx, confirmed absent from the production build via grep of frontend/dist. Whichever story mounts LoginScreen into App.jsx (expected: AUTH-05) MUST first replace this mock with a real backend call (AUTH-02's login endpoint) — mounting it unreplaced would ship a universal auth bypass.

This story's T-01 adds an in-memory-header setAuthToken(token) to userApi.js, exactly as anticipated by AUTH-04's PLAN.md ADR-3 (which declares AUTH-04 the authoritative implementer with a localStorage-backed version). AUTH-04 is already implemented and pushed on a separate, unmerged branch (feature/AUTH-04). Whichever PR merges second (expected: AUTH-01, since AUTH-04 already exists) will hit a merge conflict on this function and must resolve by keeping AUTH-04's localStorage-backed version, discarding this story's in-memory variant — a mechanical, single-function replacement per ADR-3's own consequences section, not a design problem.
pending_carry_forward.evidence: feature/AUTH commit a401e1b8 — merged feature/AUTH-04 into the shared feature/AUTH integration branch, removed AUTH-01's in-memory setAuthToken duplicate from frontend/src/services/userApi.js, kept AUTH-04's localStorage-backed version per its ADR-3. Verified frontend 59/59 tests, npm run build, backend 47/47 pytest all pass post-merge.
